prereg.estimand: Delta CER_link = CER_link(CRC-BH, M_fuse seed 0) - CER_link(CRC-BH, M_stat), metric cer_link_mean (mean over test incidents with a positive denominator)
prereg.multiplicity: Holm over the two alphas at 0.05
prereg.robustness: seeds 1-4 of M_fuse and cer_link_pooled reported, not tested
prereg.success: iff the Holm-adjusted lower confidence bound of Delta is > 0 AND the two-sided 95% CIs of Delta for BOTH placebos (fuse_perm_s0, fuse_band_s0) contain 0 at both alphas
prereg.test: one-sided paired incident-pool bootstrap (same resampled incidents and splits for both banks; B = 1000, 50 splits per replicate), H0: Delta <= 0

decision.success_rule: PREREG: Holm-adjusted lower confidence bound of Delta > 0 AND both placebos' two-sided 95% CIs contain 0 at both alphas; reported per alpha (success = at least one alpha rejected by Holm with the placebo condition met)
